name: Fasttrack
abilities: Enhanced strength (carried Hulka and Tack, Gwen and Kevin at speed)
weaknesses: Opponents with sharp reflexes can clothesline him (Sir George)
Hard to stop when running too fast
summary: A sleek blue-and-black cat speedster introduced late in Ultimate Alien as Ben's fast alien - quick, agile, and little else.
traits: Only appears in Ultimate Alien Season 3
Blade-like spikes on arms and legs
notableFeats: Saved Tack and Hulka from a Nuclear Fusion Grenade blast (Basic Training)
Disarmed the Forever Knights in seconds (A Knight to Remember)
Tried to steal Ascalon from Sir George (Solitary Alignment)
Escaped the Scrutins with Gwen and Kevin in tow (Enemy of My Frenemy)
Defeated the spying Esoterica (The Beginning of the End)

appearances.designNotes: Black suit-like body with blue hands, legs, chest and head, black mask-fins around green eyes, lightning-bolt chest design, arm/leg blade spikes; Ultimatrix symbol on chest.

image.label: UA
image.notes: only infobox image (unlabelled but named UA official); Fasttrack appears only in UA

scoring.rationale: Fast enough to outrun a missile (speed 8) and carry two people while doing it, but that is the whole kit: no ranged attack, ordinary toughness, and Sir George stopped him cold with an outstretched arm.

notes: Never used on-screen in Omniverse (only video games / online games).
Also used by Albedo (Negative Fasttrack, dream).
